selection: Best validation macro F1 within fixed 25 epochs; no hyperparameter search
test_policy: Do not evaluate test until all six stages and variants are frozen; one final fixed-protocol report
capacity_controls: Static baseline width chosen solely by nearest parameter count for each recurrent variant, never by scores
claim_scope: Exploratory masked canonical-pair prediction on contextual experimental chains; not isolated-RNA generalization or physical cotranscriptional kinetics
world_model_scope: Only algorithmic next-state feature prediction, compared to persistence; no physical-world-model claim
